title: The Midnight Oath
author: N. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Bram Lockridge, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
